talk.jaymoskingdoms.steam_captain.ask: She's fired up and the wind's fair. Where to?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.steam_captain.nowher: Nowhere to fly her. There's no other town of ours to land at.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.steam_captain.taken: Another ship's in that berth now. Another time.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.steam_captain.fouled: Her lines are fouled. Here's your money back.
